name: Three-step pipeline, site to goal to run
looks: The full wordmark holds at the top. Below it, three small pill cards sit left to right, each numbered and labelled (a URL, a plain-language goal, a run command), thin connecting lines drawing between them left to right as each one lands.
build: fan-out-branch-diagram run as a straight left-to-right chain instead of a fan: each connector is a short strokeDashoffset line between adjacent pills, landing just before the next pill fades in, numbered badges popping in with each.
sound: A tick per pill landing and a soft whoosh per connecting line.
prompt: Show a three-step pipeline as a left-to-right chain of small numbered, labelled cards, each connected to the next by a drawn line that lands just before the following card appears, so the whole flow reads as one continuous hand-off.
